extension.description: See remaining Codex and Antigravity quota in the VS Code status bar.
command.refresh.title: Refresh Codex Quota
command.refreshAntigravity.title: Refresh Antigravity Quota
configuration.refreshIntervalSeconds.des: Seconds to wait after a quota query finishes before starting the next automatic query.
configuration.executablePath.description: Absolute path to the Codex executable (codex.exe on Windows). Leave blank to find Codex in the official extension or on PATH.
Absolute path to the Google Antigravity CLI (agy.exe on Windows). Leave blank to find it on PATH or in its default install directory.
